verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents several natural-language interfaces. Ask AI answers plain-language questions with follow-ups, Auto Labels are defined by short AI prompts, plain-language instructions personalize writing, and phrases are turned into full emails. Its official MCP server lets users drive Superhuman Mail from Claude or ChatGPT to summarize threads, draft and send email, and schedule meetings with a single prompt. However, action-taking natural-language operation is evidenced mainly through external AI assistants via MCP. The in-app Cmd+K command palette is action-based, not documented as accepting natural language. Missing for 10: a documented in-app natural-language command interface for performing arbitrary actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Just ask: _"where is the q2 offsite"_, _"when is my flight"_, _"where am I staying"_, and we'll immediately generate succinct answers.
You can ask follow-up questions in a conversation.
You can now drive Superhuman Mail from Claude, ChatGPT, and your favorite AI tools.

so you can summarize threads, draft and send emails, and schedule meetings without jumping between apps
You can even make your own Auto Labels with short AI prompts like "job applications" or "requests to review work".
Add plain-language instructions like "write in lowercase" or "use this booking link" to personalize your writing and scheduling features.
Just jot down some phrases, and we'll turn them into a full email.
